description: Experimental assembled recipe from individually exercised fragments; the combined recipe has not yet been replayed end-to-end. Requires fresh live installer at 1280x800, US layout, one new 100 GiB NVMe SEKKA_JEV_TEST disk. Synthetic credentials only. Erases that disposable disk; selects all six desktops and normal GDM. Does not certify the ISO.
